blocks.html:
This method creates a new promotion. It sends a request to the
[Create Promotion](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#promotions\_postpromotions)
API route.

children.name: code
children.description: The promotion's code.

children.name: is_automatic
children.description:
Whether the promotion is applied automatically
or requires the customer to manually apply it
by entering the code at checkout.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the promotion is tax inclusive.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of promotion.

children.name: status
children.description: The status of the promotion.

children.name: campaign_id
children.description: The ID of the campaign that the promotion belongs to.

children.name: campaign
children.description: The campaign that the promotion belongs to.

children.name: name
children.description: The campaign's name.

children.name: description
children.description: The campaign's description.

children.name: campaign_identifier
children.description: The campaign's identifier.

children.name: starts_at
children.description: The date the campaign and its promotions start at.

children.name: ends_at
children.description: The date the campaign and its promotions end at.

children.name: budget
children.description: The campaign's budget.

children.name: application_method
children.description: The application method of the promotion.

children.name: description
children.description: The description of the application method.

children.name: value
children.description: The value of the application method.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the application method.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The max quantity allowed in the cart for the associated promotion to be applied.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of the application method.

children.name: target_type
children.description:
The target type of the application method indicating whether the associated promotion is applied
to the cart's items, shipping methods, or the whole order.

children.name: allocation
children.description:
The allocation value that indicates whether the associated promotion is applied on each
item in a cart or split between the items in the cart.

children.name: target_rules
children.description: The target rules of the application method.

children.name: buy_rules
children.description: The buy rules of the application method.

children.name: apply_to_quantity
children.description: The quantity of the application method.

children.name: buy_rules_min_quantity
children.description:
The minimum quantity required for a `buyget` promotion to be applied. For example,
if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value of this attribute is 2.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be used.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules of the promotion.

children.name: operator
children.description:
The operator used to check whether the buy rule applies on a cart.
For example, `eq` means that the cart's value for the specified attribute
must match the specified value.

children.name: description
children.description: The description of the promotion rule.

children.name: attribute
children.description: The attribute to compare against when checking whether a promotion can be applied on a cart.

children.name: values
children.description: The value to compare against when checking whether a promotion can be applied on a cart.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.
